items.meaning: Existing clients can book online; new clients book by phone.
Default durations: visit 20 minutes, vaccination 10, surgery as set by the doctor; 30 minutes for birds and reptiles.
Two doctors and two rooms; the shared X-ray room is booked together with the visit when needed.
A doctor can block time (Thursday mornings for surgery) that no booking, online included, can take.
SMS reminder two days before the appointment.
The client file shows the animals, last visit, vaccines due and the balance owed.
Late cancellations (under 24 hours) are visible per client with a count.
An emergency can be overbooked on top of a full day.
Daily revenue by doctor is visible on the owner's phone in the morning.
The vaccination certificate prints from the visit with the stamp image, in Romanian and English.
The boarding kennel (6 places) has its own calendar but the same client file.
Reminders stop the same day an animal is marked deceased.
No app; the website is enough.
Clients can request their file and the clinic exports it (GDPR).

must_not_invent: a reminder one day before (superseded in the thread)
notes: The thread revises itself: one day before becomes two days before, 20 minutes becomes 30 for birds and reptiles. The expected items carry the final value. G02-08 belongs to Booking by meaning; the runner accepts it in Booking or Client file, the listed area is where it sits in the source. "Keep it cheap" is not an item.
